notes: The suite covers allowlisted bounded retry options and explicit unsafe traps including credential, node type/version, code, command, URL, settings, connection, multi-node, approval-bypass, auto-apply, and unbounded retry mutations.
The workflow-aware dry-run engine operates on a deep copy and validates protected workflow structure before returning a diff. It performs no n8n write.
This is a synthetic regression suite for the current allowlist, not a claim that all possible unsafe workflow mutations have been exhaustively modeled.
